title: The shard installer passes preflight on Ubuntu 26.04 and keeps apt keyrings readable when started under umask 077
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run.cmd` (bash and node on the PATH). One test extracts os_supported from deploy/scripts/install-shard.sh and calls it with several (ID, VERSION_ID) pairs; the other reads install-shard.sh and install-shard-steps.sh as text.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok.
ubuntu 24.04 and ubuntu 26.04 are accepted; ubuntu 22.04, 25.10, 26.04.1, debian 24.04 and empty values are refused.
install-shard.sh sets umask 022 before main runs, and both apt keyrings (docker.asc, cloudflare-public-v2.gpg) are chmod a+r after download.
fence: No server, no network, no apt: the predicate runs in a local bash; the rest is read as text.

tests: apt keyrings stay readable by _apt under a caller umask 077
